title: Tryon Creek Eco-tour With a Master Naturalist
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for travelers who may have trouble with rough or hilly trails.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Ever wonder what animals and plants you're seeing when you hike and what makes each one special? Wish you could have a naturalist along to help you learn more about the places you're exploring? Then this tour is for you! Not only is your guide, Rebecca Lexa, a certified Master Naturalist, but she literally wrote the book on nature identification--The Everyday Naturalist: How to Identify Animals, Plants, and Fungi Wherever You Go (Ten Speed Press, 2025). Questions are welcome and encouraged, so bring your curiosity no matter your age!
